# Razer Blade 16 2026 Europe — SRC-0280

## Source

- https://www.razer.com/eu-en/shop/pc/gaming-laptops

## Evidence

Razer's current European store lists the 2026 Blade 16 with Core Ultra 9 386H, RTX 5080, 32GB LPDDR5X-9600, 1TB and 240Hz OLED at €4399.99 in French, US, German and Nordic layouts. The 64GB variant is €5299.99. Even the cheapest eligible-layout 5080 leaves only €44.18 below the complete Dell reference before any third-year support. The CPU is an efficient H-class Panther Lake part rather than HX. No exact Belgian SKU or Belgian AZERTY listing is exposed.
